patched
section "Creating collaborative legislation" do
  9.times do |i|
    Legislation::Process.create!(projekt_phase: Projekt.all.sample.legislation_phases.first,
                                 title: Faker::Lorem.sentence(word_count: 3).truncate(60),
                                 description: Faker::Lorem.paragraphs.join("\n\n"),
                                 summary: Faker::Lorem.paragraph,
                                 additional_info: Faker::Lorem.paragraphs.join("\n\n"),
                                 proposals_description: Faker::Lorem.paragraph,
                                 start_date: Date.current + (i - 7).days,
                                 end_date: Date.current + (i - 1).days,

observation.command:
cd /workspace; python3 - <<'PY'
p="db/dev_seeds/legislation_processes.rb"
s=open(p).read()
old='''    Legislation::Process.create!(title: Faker::Lorem.sentence(word_count: 3).truncate(60),
                                 description: Faker::Lorem.paragraphs.join("\\n\\n"),'''
new='''    Legislation::Process.create!(projekt_phase: Projekt.all.sample.legislation_phases.first,
                                 title: Faker::Lorem.sentence(word_count: 3).truncate(60),
                                 description: Faker::Lorem.paragraphs.join("\\n\\n"),'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
open(p,"w").write(s)
print("patched")
PY
sed -n '1,10p' db/dev_seeds/legislation_processes.rb
